g.text: The paired design holds each extraction fixed and evaluates both endpoints against the same original source. Transitions are invented, not estimated.

g.text: Unchanged pairs illustrate faithful merging; other pairs illustrate possible losses or removal of unsupported content. Pilot omissions reflect its eight-claim cap.
